entities.summary: Lawrence Mark Sanger, also known as Larry Sanger, is an American Internet project developer and philosopher who co-founded Wikipedia, along with Jimmy Wales. Sanger coined the name Wikipedia and provided initial drafts for many of its early guidelines, including the "Neutral point of view" and "Ignore all rules" policies. Prior to Wikipedia, he was the editor-in-chief of Nupedia, another online encyclopedia and the predecessor of Wikipedia. He later worked on other encyclopedic projects, including Encyclopedia of Earth, Citizendium, and Everipedia, and advised the nonprofit American political encyclopedia Ballotpedia.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As co-founder of Wikipedia and creator of its core policies, Larry Sanger played a pivotal role in shaping the online encyclopedia's early development and influencing its global impact. His work on Nupedia and subsequent projects has had lasting effects on the way we access and contribute to knowledge.
